CustomField.description:
Administrative field used for data maintenance/integrity checks. Allows for quick queries to check for FALSE when Primary quote is TRUE, like below.
SELECT id, name, sbqq__primary__c, sbqq__opportunity2__c, sbqq__opportunity2__r.name, sbqq__opportunity2__r.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c, sbqq__opportunity2__r.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.name FROM sbqq__quote__c WHERE SBQQ__Primary__c = TRUE AND ID_Matches_Primary_Quote_on_Opp__c = FALSE AND sbqq__opportunity2__r.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c != null
CustomField.label: ID Matches Primary Quote on Opp
